UPDATE vi_refund_order SET execution_lease_token = #{token}, execution_lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 60 SECOND), execution_attempts = execution_attempts + 1,
execution_started_at = COALESCE(execution_started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), status = 'UNKNOWN',
version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','CLOSED') AND (execution_lease_until IS NULL OR execution_lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))

UPDATE vi_refund_order SET execution_started_at = COALESCE(execution_started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)),status='UNKNOWN', version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND execution_lease_token=#{token} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','CLOSED')

UPDATE vi_refund_order SET status = #{row.status}, last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_query_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), next_query_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), execution_lease_token = NULL,execution_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1,updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{row.id} AND version = #{row.version} AND execution_lease_token = #{token} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','CLOSED')

UPDATE vi_refund_order SET status = #{status},channel_refund_id = #{channelRefundId}, success_at = #{successAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, last_verified_status = #{lastVerifiedStatus}, last_verified_at = #{lastVerifiedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, last_error_code = NULL,last_query_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), next_query_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCESS','CLOSED') THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) END, execution_lease_token = NULL,execution_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1,updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE vi_aftersale_case SET refund_state = #{refundState}, case_status = 'CLOSED',resolved_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1,updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{caseId} AND review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM vi_refund_order r JOIN vi_aftersale_case c ON c.id = r.case_id JOIN vi_payment_order p ON p.id = r.payment_id JOIN vi_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE r.payment_method = 'WECHAT' AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','CLOSED') AND c.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND (c.kind = 'REFUND_ONLY' OR c.return_state <> 'WAIT_RETURN' OR o.returned_at IS NOT NULL) AND (r.next_query_at IS NULL OR r.next_query_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (r.execution_lease_until IS NULL OR r.execution_lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 100

SELECT 'PAYMENT' kind,p.id subject_id,p.order_id,p.id payment_id,p.status local_status, CASE WHEN p.capacity_resolution = 'MANUAL_CONFLICT' THEN 'CAPACITY_CONFLICT' ELSE 'PAYMENT_UNKNOWN' END reason_code FROM vi_payment_order p WHERE (p.status = 'UNKNOWN' OR p.capacity_resolution = 'MANUAL_CONFLICT') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vi_payment_reconciliation previous WHERE previous.kind='PAYMENT' AND previous.subject_id=p.id AND previous.status='RESOLVED' AND p.updated_at <= previous.resolved_at) UNION ALL SELECT 'REFUND',r.id,p.order_id,p.id,r.status,CONCAT('REFUND_',r.status) FROM vi_refund_order r JOIN vi_payment_order p ON p.id = r.payment_id WHERE r.status IN ('UNKNOWN','ABNORMAL','CLOSED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vi_payment_reconciliation previous WHERE previous.kind='REFUND' AND previous.subject_id=r.id AND previous.status='RESOLVED' AND r.updated_at <= previous.resolved_at)
